tei:div.tei:p: : bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig mthong ba rang grol bzhugs so:bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum gyi snying po'o//

sku gsum yongs 'dus lha la 'dud: chos sku pad+ma kun tu 'chang: longs sku thod phreng rigs mchog lnga: sprul sku ma nges 'gro 'dul phyir: mtshan dang bkod pa bsam yas bstan: de las dzaṃ gling o rgyan yul: dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho rdzing du: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: so sor rtog pa'i rig mdangs hrī: ya mtshan cho 'phrul mtha' yas pas: brdzus skyes thog babs tshul nyid du: rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam par snang : de tshe in+d+ra bhū ti yi: rigs kyi tshul bzung rgyal srid bskyangs: phan bde'i 'byor pa rgyas par byas: de nas brtul zhugs rol pa yis: dur khrod chen po'i gnas rnams su: gsang ba mchog gi spyod pa spyad: rlung sems las rung phyag rgya drug: rang bzhin sku gsum ston pa dang : paṇa grub dbang po brgya rtsa las: mdo rgyud thams cad thos shing sbyangs: nyams myong sgom pa'i drod rtags thon: rlung sems snang ba ro gcig pas: 'byung bzhir dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul dang : mā ra tī ka'i brag phug tu: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba thob: rgya gar yul gnas kun tu phyin: mu stegs rgol ngan mthu yis bcom: bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba byas: yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: dpal chen yang dag bsgrubs pa'i tshe: bar chad bgegs la phur bus btab: phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes brnyes: de nas gdong dmar bod yul 'dir: smon lam las 'brel btsad po yis: spyan drangs 'byung po gdug can kun: rdo rje khros pa'i shugs kyis btul: bsam yas sa gzhi yongs su bzung : mi dang mi min thams cad kun: rdzu 'phrul mthu yis bran du bkol: chos 'khor mig 'phrul lta bur grub: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: bkra shis rab gnas me tog 'thor: ngo mtshar ltas mchog mtha' yas pas: skal ldan tshogs rnams yi rangs gyur: bod la phan pa'i paṇa chen dang : lo tsā mang po lung bstan nas: sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde'i tshogs:

rgya cher bsgyur zhing bshad sgrub btsugs: gsang ba bla na med pa yi: zab rgyas rgyud lung man ngag kun: snod ldan rnams la rgyas btab nas: so so grub pa'i rtags mtshan phyung : khyad par mgrin bzang dbu rtse dang : mchims phu zab lung ti sgro sogs: bod kyi grub gnas mang po ru: mnga' bdag yab sras bai ro dang : mtsho rgyal la sogs rje 'bangs la: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi: bka' dang dgongs 'dus chos kyi mdzod: mngon sum man ngag snying tig sogs: smin grol bshad pa'i char rgyun phab: grub pa mchog gi sa la bzhag: ma 'ongs don phyir gter du sbas: gter bdag srung mar gnyer byang gtad: yon mchod mdzad pa mthar phyin nas: rje gcig rgyal po dgung du gshegs: kho bo srin yul 'gro bar chas: g.yu ru khra 'brug gtsug lag tu: rje 'bangs rnams la ngal bso'i skyes: za hor rgyal po smin byas pa'i: bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i mdzod sgo phyes: sgrub pa'i dbang mchog bskur ba'i tshe: 'chi med mkha' 'gro man+dā ras: de lta'i ngang tshul mngon shes te: skad cig bar snang glog 'khyugs bzhin: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor drung du lhags: phyag 'tshal gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang : snyoms 'jug bde ba'i mchod pa phul: thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba ni: e ma gu ru rin po che: bka' rnams 'dus pa'i snying po'i bcud: zab mo bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs: rgya cher gsungs pa'i don gyi mthil: bdag dang ma 'ongs gdul bya'i phyir: tshig nyung gnad 'dril nyams len bde: byin rlabs mngon sum 'bebs pa yi: ngo mtshar gdams pa bstan du gsol: de ltar gus pas zhus pa'i ngor: sku gsum bstan pa gnyis ldan gyi: bla ma 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs 'di: snying gi zungs khrag lta bur bstan: rang nyams longs la drod rtags phyung : dpe rgyud 'dra min gsum bris te: gcig ni ḍā ki man+dā ras: stod phyogs bal bod gnyis kyi mtshams: pur+ṇa rdza ri mthon po'i shar: pha bong dga' 'khyil 'dra ba ru:

smon lam thob la gter du sbos: rgyal po'i gdung rabs dgu yi mthar: mnga' bdag yab sras byin brlabs pa: badz+ra bha dra'i ming can dang : 'phrad nas 'gro don byed par 'gyur: gal te dus der ma thon na: rtsub 'gyur shin tu snyigs ma'i mthar: pad+ma'i ming can rig 'dzin la: o rgyan bdag gis byin brlabs shing : mkha' 'gro'i zab mo'i brdas mtshon te: yid bzhin nor bu'i snying po dbye: skal ldan 'ga' zhig thar lam 'god: gcig ni pad+ma brtsegs pa'i phug: khyab 'jug chen po'i thugs ka ru: phra men gzi yi sgrom bur sbos: rgyal sras rang gi skye bas rnyed: gcig ni khams kyi khyung phug tu: mtsho rgyal lcam gyis sbas byas na: lha sras lo tsā'i skye ba'i mtha': mchog gam las kyi ming dang 'phrad: mdor na da lta'i 'dus pa dang : ma 'ongs o rgyan rjes 'jug rnams: 'di la nyams len snying por dril: nges par bdag gis rjes su 'dzin: nyes spyod cha dang bcas pa spongs: lus ngag dge ba'i las la sbyor: mchog tu rang sems 'dul la brtson: zhal gdams snying po de kho na: nga la 'gro dang 'ong ba bral: srin yul gshegs pa ltar snang tsam: mos gus can la 'du 'bral med: gsol ba thob cig rjes 'jug rnams: 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs kun: o rgyan nga nyid dran pas chog: pad 'byung bdag gis bslu mi srid: the tshom spongs shig rjes 'jug rnams: nga la snying nas mos pa'i bu: tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag: pad+ma 'od du skye bar nges: gdung shugs skyed cig rjes 'jug rnams: de tshe o rgyan bdag nyid kyi: dgyes zhal mjal zhing gdams pa ston: myur du byang chub skal ldan 'gyur: spro ba skyed cig rjes 'jug rnams: gzhan yang mchog dang thun mong gi: dngos grub phrin las thams cad kun: nga nyid sgrub pa kho nas 'byung : brtson pas sgrubs shig rjes 'jug rnams: zhes bden pa'i tshig gis bka' stsal pas rje 'bangs 'dus pa'i tshom bu thams cad la byin rlabs kyi byin phebs:

gnam sa bla 'og 'dres pa lta bu'i mos gus kyi nyams shar: ba spu g.yo zhing mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i gdung shugs dang bcas gu ru kho na yid la byed cing gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson par gyur to: bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig las: nges shes skyed pa lo rgyus kyi le'u ste dang po'o: sa ma ya: ma 'ongs dad ldan skyes bu rnams: pad+ma bdag nyid sgrub 'dod na: dbang blangs dam tshig srog ltar bsrung : dben pa'i gnas su 'du 'dzi spangs: dkar phyogs lha klu gzhi bdag la: gtor ma sbyin zhing phrin las bcol: nag phyogs bgegs rigs srung mtshams bcad: sgrub khang phyags dar spos chus bran: sku gsung thugs rten byin can dgram: phyi nang mchod tshogs ci 'byor dang : khyad par bla ma'i gtor chen ni: bag dro brjid dang ldan pa bsham: bde ba'i stan la lus gnad bsrang : rlung ro dbyung zhing mos gus bskyed: bsam gtan snod du gyur pa na: sngon dngos rjes kyis nyams su blang : dang po sngon 'gro'i bya ba la: skyabs su 'gro zhing byang sems bskyed: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis bsags: bgegs bskrad srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom: rgyun bshags bya zhing dam bca' bzung : ye shes gzi byin lhag par dbab: gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab: de ltar las rim dgu yin no: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la: dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bskyed: gnas gsum byin brlabs ye shes bstim: bzhugs su gsol zhing rang dbang bskur: gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul: bzlas brjod bsnyen pas rtse gcig bsgrub: bstod pa bya zhing thugs dam bskul: de ltar las rim dgu la bslab: gsum pa mtha' rgyas rjes rim la: tshogs mchod 'bul zhing lha ma bsngo: tha tshig bsgrags la brtan ma bskyang : las mjug rdo rje'i bro yis bsdu: dus dang rgyun gyi dngos grub gsol: rtag mtha' sbyang zhing chad mtha' bsal: bsngo smon bya zhing shis pa brjod:

de ltar dgu yis mthar dbyung ngo : bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig las: sgrub pa'i las rim mdor bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya: sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs 'gro ni: mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams: mngon sum mazhin du sad pa'i mdun: rtse gcig gus pas skyabs 'gro bya: na mo: bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang : sku gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid la: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed gsal gdab ni: mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun don du: sku gsum bla ma bsgrubs nas ni: mchog dang thun mong phrin las kyis: gzhan don byed par sems bskyed do: gsum pa tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni: phyogs dus zhing khams rab 'byams kyi: bla ma sku gsum lha tshogs la: rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod par 'bul: sdig sgrib nyes ltung mthol zhing bshags: 'khor 'das dge la rjes yi rang : chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: phung po khams dang skye mched dang : gzung dang 'dzin pa las 'das pa'i: rang bzhin 'od gsal byang chub sems: dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan: ma lus blo yis yongs bsdoms nas: bla med chos dbyings snying por bsngo: yang dag ye shes mchog thob shog: bzhi pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ni: hūm̐: he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang : dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: khrag 'thung 'khor bcas spyan 'dren na: dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren kun: byang chub sgrub la bar gcod rnams: song zhig lha min lha yang rung : gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: gal te bka' las 'da' byed na: 'bar ba khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis: de ma thag tu bkas nas ni: bdun brgyud rigs kyang brlag par gyis: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la hūm̐:

lnga pa srung mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad kun: rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che: pad+ma ral gri'i gur gyis gtams: rab 'bar me yis kun tu khyab: khro bo khro mo sprin ltar gtibs: bskal pa'i rlung yang mi rgyu na: bar chad bgegs tshogs smos ci dgos: ye shes srung mtshams lhun gyis grub: oṃ badz+ra tsakra rat+na pad+ma tīk+ṣ+ṇa dz+wa la ram̐ ma hā kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: drug pa rgyun bshags bya ba ni: hoḥ sems nyid rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag kyang : ma rig 'khrul pas sgro dang skur btab ste: nyon mongs dbang gyur las sgrib ci bsags pa: thams cad ro mnyam chos sku'i ngang du bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya bi shud+dhe a a: bdun pa dam bca' bzung ba ni: oṃḥ dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing : rig 'dzin bla ma bsgrub par dam bcas ltar: deng nas bzung ste bla med snying po'i bar: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje mi gtong bzung : kā ya wa kā tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: brgyad pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: ma bcos spros bral dbyings kyi zhing khams nas: bla ma chos sku'i lha tshogs sku bzhengs shig: 'khrul pa ka nas dag pa'i byin chen phob: lhun grub thig le chen po'i dbang mchog bskur: bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i zhing khams nas: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs sku sku bzhengs shig: gzung 'dzin dbyings su zhi ba'i byin chen phob: ye shes rig rtsal rgyas pa'i dbang mchog bskur: 'gro 'dul mi zad rgyan gyi zhing khams nas: bla ma sprul sku'i lha tshogs sku bzhengs shig: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa'i byin chen phob: mi phyed rdo rje gsum gyi dbang mchog skur: hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs sras dang bcas: mkha' khyab chos sku'i dgongs pa lams se lam: rang byung longs sku'i ye shes ta la la: 'grau 'dul sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul shigs se shig: rdo rje'i sku yi gar stabs khyugs se khyug:

snying po sngags kyi dzab dbyangs 'u ru ru: bde chen thugs rje'i sprin phung thibs se thib: smin grol yon tan char 'bebs sha ra ra: rnam bzhi'i phrin las 'bras bu spungs se spung : rtag rgyun rang bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin: bdag cag mos pa'i gdung bas rgyud bskul na: gdul bya yul la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyis: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir skur bzhengs shig: byin chen byin phob rab 'byams rtsa ba gsum: dbang chen skur cig rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs: dngos grub stsol cig yi dam zhi khro'i lha: bar chad bdud thul mkha' 'gro ging laṅka: myur ba nyid du gnas 'dir byin phob cig: rnal 'byor rgyud la bde chen ye shes spor: sgrub pa'i gnas mchog bde chen zhing du sgyur: phyi nang dam rdzas 'dod yon bcud du skyil: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phob: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dharma kā ya dz+nyā na sa ma ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru saṃ bho ga kā ya dz+nyā na sa ma ya staṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru nirmā ṇa kā ya dz+nyā na sa ma ya ā be shā ya a āḥ hrīṃ hrīṃ: pheṃ pheṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dgu pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ swā bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bha wa shud+dho3haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las gnas yul kun: lām̐ las sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha': 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing : mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gzhir: oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad kyi: rang bzhin gzhal med khang chen po: gdugs 'phen bla bre ba dan rgyan: rin chen nor bu'i drwa bas spel: de dbus 'bru gsum yongs gyur las: phyi nang nyer spyod 'dod yon tshogs: mchod pa'i phyag rgya nam mkha'i mdzod: mkha' khyab sprin phung 'phro bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐:

oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra nai bid+ya āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pū dza me gha sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: oṃḥ mtshan ldan bhan+dha yangs pa'i nang : oṃ yig 'od du zhu ba las: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i: bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bcud du 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: āḥ lcang lor bcas pa'i ka pā lar: āṃḥyig 'od du zhu ba las: khams gsum bsgral ba'i khrag gi mtsho: chags pa'i lbu phreng phyogs bcur g.yo: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: hūm̐: rin chen pad+ma bhañdza'i nang : hūm̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las: sha lnga bdud rtsi mnyam sbyar ba'i: gtor ma 'dod 'byung lhun por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: de las gzhan yang ye shes sprin: kun tu bzang po'i rol mo las: mchod pa'i char rgyun mi zad pas: phyogs dus kun tu khyab par brdal: oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta: pra ra ṇi ta: sam̐ pra ra ṇi ta: sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni: pradz+nyā pā' ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha we: badz+ra pad+ma hri da ya: san+toṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ho ho ho āḥkham̐ swā hā: oṃ badz+ra s+phar ṇa khaṃ: rol mor bcas pas byin dbab bo: bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig las: sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro'i las rim bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o: sa ma ya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las rim la: dang po rten dang brten pa yi: dam tshig 'khor lo bskyed pa ni: oṃ: 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kun: gdod nas spros bral de bzhin nyid: smra bsam brjod 'das chos kyi sku: 'od gsal thig le chen por rdzogs: oṃ mā hā shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa wa at+ma ko3haṃ: āḥ de ltar ma rtogs sems can la: dmigs med snying rje sgyu ma'i tshul: bde chen ye shes longs spyod rdzogs: 'khor ba myang 'das kun tu snang :

oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na kā ru ṇi ka sa ma ya ho: hūm̐: stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa: dkyil 'khor thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu: sprul pa'i yi ge hūm̐ mthing ga: mkha' la 'ja' tshon bzhin du shar: oṃ badz+ra dhā tu dz+nyā na hūm̐ sa ma ye s+t+waṃ: hūm̐: rgyu yi hūm̐ yig 'bar ba las: 'od 'phros snod bcud gzung 'dzin kun: rdo rje stong pa nyid du sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis: e 'phros dbyings phyug nam mkha'i klong : yam̐ 'phros sgrol ma rlung du 'khyil: ram̐ 'phros gos dkar me rlung 'bar: bam̐ 'phros mā kī'i rgya mtshor bskyil: lam̐ 'phros spyan ma gser gyi gzhir: bh+rūm̐ 'phros rin chen ri rab steng : hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi 'phro 'du las: rdo rje'i srung 'khor brtan cing yangs: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i bkod pa rdzogs: de dbus bh+rūm̐ yig yongs gyur las: rin chen sna bzhi las grub pa'i: gzhal med khang chen 'od du 'bar: rtsig pa pha gu drwa ba dang : drwa phyed mda' yab shar bus mdzes: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi: ri dwags chos 'khor gdugs kyis brgyan: dbus phyur rdo rje nor bu'i tog: ye shes 'od zer kun tu 'phro: rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi: snam bur mchod pa'i rig ma 'khod: phyi rol khrus rdzing skyed mos tshal: yid 'phrog bkod pa brjod las 'das: sprul pa'i pho brang chen po'i dbus: pad+ma 'dab bzhi rin chen brgyad: mu khyud lnga ldan khyams dang bcas: rigs kyi kha dog 'od du 'bar: phyi nang sgrib med zang thal le: sku gsum bzhugs gnas chen por rdzogs: bh+rūm̐ ma hā dz+nyā na bi mā na sa ma ya hūm̐: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor pad+ma'i snying po ru: seng ges bteg pa'i rin chen khri: rdo rje pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: 'od phung thig ler 'khyil ba'i dbus: nam mkhar gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig babs: 'od zer 'phro 'du'i sbyor ba las: gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i: lte bar hūm̐ yig mtshan par gyur:

de las ye shes 'od kyi sprin: rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing kun 'phros: rgyal ba rnams la dgyes mchod phul: byin rlabs dngos grub rang dbang bsgyur: 'gro ba kun gyi las sgrib sbyangs: sangs rgyas mdzad pa rab tu bsgrubs: tshur 'dus bde stong rol pa'i ngang : mthing gsal 'od kyi gong bur 'bar: hūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: sam̐ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: hūm̐: de nyid yongs gyur skad cig gis: rigs kyi gtso mchog dkyil 'khor bdag: gu ru pad+ma kun tu 'chang : mthing gsal nam mkha' dwangs pa'i mdog: phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol: rang 'od yum dang dgyes par 'khril: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhi 'dzum sgeg cing khro bo'i nyams: rdo rje pad+ma'i skyil krung gis: 'od zer bsam yas klong yangs su: bde stong ye shes snying por sbyor: dgongs klong 'du 'bral med pa yi: chos sku'i bla ma bsam mi khyab: ma bcos lhun rdzogs chen por gsal: oṃ badz+ra gu ru dharma kā ya maṇ+ḍa la āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mdun dang phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab la: seng ge glang chen rta mchog dang : rma bya shang shang rin chen khri: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: gtso bo yab yum snyoms zhugs pa'i: ye shes lnga ldan byang chub sems: hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥyig 'phros: 'od zer spros bsdus yongs gyur las: dbus su badz+ra thod phreng mthing : rdo rje bdud rtsi'i thod pa bsnams: shar du bud+dha thod phreng dkar: 'khor lo bdud rtsi'i thod pa bsnams: lho ru rat+na thod phreng ser: rin chen bdud rtsi'i thod pa bsnams: nub tu pad+ma thod phreng dmar: pad+ma bdud rtsi'i thod pa bsnams: byang du karma thod phreng ljang : rgya gram bdud rtsi'i thod pa bsnams: kun kyang khro 'dzum spyan gsum 'bar: rigs kyi gsang gos phod chen bklubs: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: g.yas pas phyag mtshan thugs kar gtod: phyag g.yon dkur brten yum la 'khyud:

zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: pang du rang rang rigs kyi yum: gri gug thod pa bsnams pas 'khril: bde stong kha sbyor ye shes las: longs sku'i bla ma sprin ltar gtibs: 'od zer gzi brjid dpal du 'bar: snang stong zung 'jug chen por gsal: oṃ badz+ra gu ru saṃ bho ga kā ya maṇ+ḍa la āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: de phyir rat+na zur brgyad dbus: rin chen mdzes khri pad zla'i steng : gtso bo yab yum sbyor mtshams nas: hrīḥyig zung re 'phros pa las: shar du kun bzang pad+ma 'byung : mthing gsal skyil krung rdor dril bsnams: longs sku'i chas rdzogs g.yon phyogs su: mtsho gling mkha' 'gro snang gsal ma: rin chen gzi ldan sgron me 'degs: lho ru 'jam dpal mchog sred rtsal: dkar ser ḍā ru pad phor 'dzin: sngags kyi chas rdzogs phyed skyil g.yon: bde ba'i rnal 'byor dri chab ma: bsung zhim dri bzang bdud rtsi sbreng : nub tu thugs chen pad+ma'i rgyal: dmar gsal ḍā ru me long bsnams: rgyal po'i cha byad rol stabs g.yon: 'od 'chang lha mo glu dbyangs ma: snyan 'gyur bai ḍūr pi waṃ 'khrol: byang du sgrib sel shākya seng: gser mdog rdo rje lhung bzed 'dzin: sa gnon mnyam bzhag sprul sku'i chas: g.yon du zhi 'tsho me tog ma: lha rdzas me tog char chen 'bebs: shar lhor nam snying nyi ma'i 'od: ser gsal kha ṭ+wāṃ nyi zer 'dzin: rnal 'byor cha lugs rol stabs g.yon: bdag med rnal 'byor phreng ba ma: rin chen sna tshogs do shal thogs: lho nub byams pa saṃ bha wa: mnyam bzhag pad phor skyabs sbyin mdzad: dge slong cha lugs sems skyil g.yon: su kha dha ri bdug pa ma: dri zhim spos kyi khang bzang 'dzin: nub byang gsang bdag seng ge'i sgra: mthing nag rdo rje sdigs mdzub bsgrengs: khro bo'i chas rdzogs g.yon brkyang bzhugs: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro gar mkhan ma: rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgyas rol: byang shar sa snying gro bo lod:

dmar smug rdo rje phur bu 'dril: 'chol ba'i chas can rol stabs g.yon: phra men mkha' 'gro sgeg pa ma: snyems pa'i tshul 'dzin me long ngom: lha mo thams cad dkar dngar mdangs: zhi 'dzum chags nyams mchog tu rgyas: dar dang rin chen ut+pal brgyan: phyed skyil rol pa'i 'gying bag bcas: gtso la 'dun pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: gnyis med bde chen 'od zer sprin: sprul sku'i bla ma bsam yas 'char: gang 'dul bkod pa dbyings kyi rgyan: ma 'gags rang shar chen por gsal: oṃ badz+ra gu ru nirmā ṇa kā ya maṇ+ḍal āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: de yi phyi rim lnga ldan gyi: mu khyud so so'i phyogs bcu'i char: pad 'dab nyi shu'i lte ba ru: seng khri pad+ma zla ba'i gdan: mdun du rin chen pad zla bcas: 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus: gtso bo yab yum sbyor mtshams nas: hūm̐ dang hrī yig phreng ba 'phros: de rnams yongs su gyur pa las: mi 'gyur sku yi mu khyud la: shar nas brtsams te g.yas skor du: thub pa'i dbang po dri med sgra: dkon mchog sprin dang yon tan 'byung : seng ge'i sgra chen mdzes pa'i tog: gzi brjid rgyal dang tsan+dan dri: snying rje'i rgyal po mngon spro rgyal: bde gshegs rin chen rgyal po rnams: dkar gsal byang chub phyag rgya 'ching : sprul sku'i cha lugs skyil krung bzhugs: de rnams mdun du rim pa bzhin: gu ru pad+ma skyes bzang dkar: mu tig phreng ba chos 'chad mdzad: pad+ma lhun grub 'od kor ser: sa gnon rdo rje rin chen 'dzin: pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar: mchog sbyin pad phreng skyabs sbyin mdzad: pad+ma ye grub mtha' bral ljang : rgyal mtshan bsgrengs shing gter bum 'chang : pad+ma 'khrul zhig seng ge smug: kha ṭ+rām̐ rtse gsum bhan+dha bsnams: gu ru pad+ma 'dzum bzhad dmar: thal sbyar bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin: pad+ma thugs rje 'gro 'dul smug: skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag rgya gram bsnams: pad+ma 'jig rten dbang phyug ser:

rin chen me tog snye ma 'dzin: pad+ma rgyal mtshan me tog sngo: ut+pal sdong bu khang bzang bsnams: pad+ma rdo rje snying po ljang : mnyam gzhag rin chen ri rab 'dzin: kun kyang pad zhu ber phod gsol: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhabs zung phyed skyil rol pas bzhugs: 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba'i klong : mi 'gyur sku yi 'khor lor rdzogs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru kā ya dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: de phyir gsung gi mu khyud la: phyogs bcu'i pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus: seng khri pad+ma zla ba'i steng : thub pa'i dbang po 'od zer yangs: dka' thub rgyal po gtsug tor snying : nges par sbyor ba nges par gsung : bde ba chen po dbang po'i dbyangs: grags pa'i dpal dang sprul pa'i rgyal: bde gshegs sgra dbyangs mi zad rnams: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag phyag rgya mdzad: sprul sku'i cha lugs skyil krung bzhugs: de rnams mdun nas rim pa bzhin: rin chen mdzes khri pad zla'i steng : pad+ma rab tu kun skyong dkar: bdud rtsi'i bum pa gser thur 'dzin: pad+ma g.yul las rgyal ba ljang : ral gri gdengs shing skyabs sbyin mdzad: pad+ma sa mkhan skyabs mgon mthing : chos 'chad phyag rgya glegs bam 'chang : gu ru pad+ma ko ṣa ṇi: gser mdog glegs bam lhung bzed bsnams: pad+ma las ster bshes gnyan ser: phyag gnyis nyi ma me long 'dzin: pad+ma 'khor ba'i gcong 'byin smug: bdud rtsi'i shel bum ut+pal bsnams: pad+ma 'dod rgu rang 'byung ni: dmar ser ral gri glegs bam 'dzin: pad+ma 'dren pa'i dpa' bo mthing : phyag gnyis rdo rje phur bu 'dril: pad+ma bka' rtags rgyal po ni: ljang gsal mnyam gzhag rgya gram bsnams: pad+ma klong yangs dam pa'i dpal: ser nag me chu'i 'khor lo 'dzin: kun kyang pad zhu ber phod gsol: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhabs zung phyed skyil rol pas bzhugs: 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba'i klong :

zag med gsung gi 'khor lor rdzogs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru wā ka dz+nyān maṇ+ḍal āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: de phyi thugs kyi mu khyud la: phyogs bcu'i pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus: seng khri pad+ma zla ba'i steng : thub pa'i dbang po sman pa'i rgyal: myur du 'dzin dang dga' ba'i spyan: dgongs pa'i rgyal po gser gyi snying : 'od zer dpal dang zhi ba'i dbang : sprin gyi dpal dang yid 'ong dbyangs: bde gshegs me long snang ba rnams: mthing gsal sa gnon mnyam gzhag mdzad: sprul sku'i cha lugs skyil krung bzhugs: de rnams mdun nas rim pa bzhin: rin chen mdzes khri pad zla'i steng : pad+ma spyod yul rnam dag dkar: bdud rtsi sman gyi bum bzang 'dzin: pad+ma 'khor ba dong sprugs dmar: thal sbyar nyi zer 'od zhags bsgreng : pad+ma rang byung ye shes mthing : mnyam gzhag gdud rtsi'i thod pa bsnams: pad+ma bde ba'i shugs 'chang ljang : sa gnon skyabs sbyin khang bzang 'dzin: pad+ma yang snying rang grol ljang : rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu brten: pad+ma chos dbyings dpal 'bar mthing : phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag ting 'dzin bzhugs: pad+ma kun skyong chen po ni: ljang gsal skyabs sbyin 'khor lo 'chang : pad+ma gser gyi ri dbang ser: mchog sbyin dang ni bum pa 'dzin: pad+ma rgyal po'i me long mthing : phyag gnyis shel phreng pad+ma 'chang : pad+ma mthon mthing lhab lhub ni: sngo skya klu shing dril bu 'dzin: kun kyang pad zhu ber phod gsol: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhabs zung phyed skyil rol pas bzhugs: 'od zer mthing ga 'phro ba'i klong : bde chen thugs kyi 'khor lor rdzogs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru tsit+ta dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: de phyi yon tan mu khyud la: phyogs bcu'i pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus: seng khri pad+ma zla ba'i steng : thub pa'i dbang po shākya'i rgyal: zla 'od dpal dang nyi ma'i snying : spos kyi rgyal po gser 'od 'phro:

bkod pa'i rgyal po gser gyi bzung ཿ dpal gyi rgyal po bde ba 'byin: bde gshegs mya ngan med dpal rnams: ser gsal sa gnon mnyam gzhag mdzad: sprul sku'i cha lugs skyil krung bzhugs: de rnams mdun nas rim pa bzhin: rin chen mdzes khri pad zla'i steng : pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar dmar mdangs: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bhan+dha 'dzin: pad+ma yid snang cod pan dkar: mkhar gsil bsgreng zhing lhung bzed 'chang : pad+ma in+d+ra nī la sngo: kha ṭ+wāṃ gsor zhing pad+ma 'dzin: pad+ma rnam dag ye shes ljang : mnyam gzhag sprul pa bsam yas spro: pad+ma gser gyi 'od 'phro ser: nor bu'i phreng ba pad sdong 'dzin: pad+ma rigs ldan dpa' bo smug: rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol: pad+ma 'brug chen lhun rdzogs mthing : rdo rje gdengs shing phur bu 'dril: pad+ma skye 'chi gnyis spangs dmar: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: pad+ma 'jigs pa bde 'byin ni: dkar dmar me chu'i dkyil 'khor bsnams: pad+ma chos legs mthong dga' sngo: bdud rtsi'i ste ba dung phor 'dzin: kun kyang pad zhu ber phod gsol: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhabs zung phyed skyil rol pas bzhugs: 'od zer ser po 'phro ba'i klong : 'dod 'byung yon tan 'khor lor rdzogs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru gu+u ṇa dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: de phyi phrin las mu khyud la: phyogs bcu'i pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus: seng khri pad+ma zla ba'i steng : thub pa'i dbang po dga' ba'i mchog: gzi brjid dpal dang dge rtsa skyed: ngan song sbyong ba 'jig rten 'dren: rnam par rgyal ba me tog bkod: thams cad snang ba tsan+dan dri: bde gshegs seng ge 'bum gzugs rnams: ljang gsal skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag mdzad: sprul sku'i cha lugs skyil krung bzhugs: de rnams mdun nas rim pa bzhin: rin chen mdzes khri pad zla'i steng : pad+ma spyi bcings nam mkha' mthing :

chos 'chad mnyam gzhag glegs bam bsnams: pad+ma saṃ u pak+ṣa dkar: bai ḍūr pi waṃ snyan par sgrogs: pad+ma rin chen phra spras ser: phyag gnyis rin chen mchod sdong 'degs: pad+ma byer bkram rgya yan mthing : phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag 'khor lo bsnams: pad+ma mi nub rgyal mtshan dmar: gser gyi rgyal mtshan glegs bam 'chang : pad+ma mun pa snang byed ni: dmar ser nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin: pad+ma byams pa'i snang ba ser: mchog sbyin bdud rtsi'i spyi blugs sbreng : pad+ma 'khor ba gcod byed mthing : phyag gnyis ral gri me long gdengs: pad+ma rol pa rnam dag ni: ljang gsal sa gnon mnyam gzhag mdzad: pad+ma rnam par grol ba ljang : phyag gnyis rgya gram thod bum 'dzin: kun kyang pad zhu ber phod gsol: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhabs zung phyed skyil rol pas bzhugs: 'od zer ljang gu 'phro ba'i klong : gang 'dul phrin las 'khor lor rdzogs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru karma dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mu khyud lnga ldan phyogs bcu yi: pad+ma 'dab stong rgyas pa'i dbus: mi mjed 'jig rten ston pa mchog: bskal bzang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang : de mdun nyi dang 'od zer bzhin: sngags kyi ston pa pad+ma 'byung : kun kyang sku mdog phyag rgya dang : rgyan dang cha lugs phyag mtshan rnams: rang rang rigs kyi gtso bo'i tshul: 'od zer gzi brjid lham me ba: bde gshegs rig 'dzin sprin phung 'phro: 'gro 'dul dkyil 'khor chen por rdzogs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru maṇ+ḍa la āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: slar yang gtso bo yab yum gnyis: snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas: ye shes drug gi hrī:yig 'phros: dkyil 'khor khyams su babs pa las: shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon pad zla'i steng : lha yi gu ru srid thub 'dzin: dkar ser rdo rje dril bu bsnams: dar dang rin chen sna tshogs brgyan: zhabs gnyis gar stabs tshul gyis bzhengs:

lha min gu ru rnam par rgyal: ljang nag 'khar gsil lhung bzed 'dzin: chos gos gsum gsol sprul sku'i tshul: zhabs zung mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs: dkyil 'khor lho phyogs pad zla'i steng : mi yi gu ru pad+ma 'byung : dkar dmar rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: pad zha gsang phod chos gos gsol: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: nub sgo'i g.yas su pad zla'i steng : byol song gu ru seng rab brtan: mthing nag cang te'u dril bu 'khrol: dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: zhabs gnyis gar stabs tshul gyis rol: g.yon du pad+ma nyi ma'i steng : yi dwags gu ru rnam snang byed: smugs nag rdo rje phur bu 'dril: khro bo'i chas rdzogs dor stabs bzhengs: dkyil 'khor byang phyogs pad nyi'i steng : dmyal ba'i gu ru rnam par gnon: dmar nag rdo rje sdig pa bsnams: 'jigs rung khro chas dor stabs 'gying : kun kyang rang mdog 'od zer las: mtshan dang rnam 'phrul bsam yas spro: rigs drug sdug bsngal dong nas sprugs: gang 'dul dkyil 'khor chen por rdzogs: oṃ sarba dz+nyā na ma hā gu ru maṇ+ḍa la āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi'i dbus: pad nyi bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng : gtso bo yab yum sbyor mtshams nas: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ'i yi ge 'phros: yongs gyur shar du rnam rgyal dkar: lcags kyu dril 'dzin yum dang sbyor: lho ru gshin rje gshed po ser: zhags pa dril 'dzin yum dang sbyor: nub tu dbang chen rta mgrin dmar: lcags sgrog dril 'dzin yum dang sbyor: byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang : rgya gram dril 'dzin yum dang sbyor: kun kyang khro bo 'jigs pa'i chas: ye shes me dbus dor stabs bzhengs: las byed pho nya sprin ltar spro: bka' nyan dkyil 'khor chen por rdzogs: ma hā kro dha dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥmaṇ+ḍal āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang steng 'og tu: dgongs brda snyan nas byon pa yi:

rig 'dzin bla ma sprin ltar gtibs: zhi khro sgrub sde brgyad la sogs: yi dam lha tshogs 'ja' ltar shar: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs: grangs med nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrigs: kun kyang rnam 'gyur ma nges pas: mchog thun phrin las cir yang mdzad: sgyur ma chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin: gsal stong zung 'jug 'od kyi sku: snang srid gzhir bzhengs chen por rdzogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba maṇ+ḍa la āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: de ltar gsal ba'i lha tshogs kyi: spyi bo zla steng oṃ dkar gsal: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi: rdo rje'i sku ru byin brlabs gyur: oṃ sarba thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: mgrin par pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i dbus: āḥyig dmar po 'od du 'bar: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi: rdo rje'i gsung du byin brlabs gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā wā ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ: thugs kar rdo rje'i lte ba ru: hūm̐ yig mthing ga 'od du 'bar: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi: rdo rje'i thugs su byin brlabs gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ: gsum pa ye shes dgug bstim ni: spos dang rol mo'i brdas bskul te: gdung ba'i dbyangs bcas spyan drang ngo : hūm̐ hrī: phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa yi: sku gsum bla ma bde gshegs tshogs: khyab brdal chos dbyings chen po las: ye shes sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐: 'od gsal dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rig rtsal pad+ma kun tu 'chang : chos sku'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bde chen rang byung zhing khams nas: rigs lnga thod phreng yab dang yum: rab 'byams longs sku'i 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan= rang byung dur khrod chen po nas: sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:

rnam 'phrul sna tshogs sprin bzhin gtibs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren= mi mjed zhing khams rab 'byams nas: 'gro 'dul bkod pa bsam mi khyab: dus gsum bde gshegs rig 'dzin tshogs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren= sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i zhing mchog nas: rigs drug dong sprugs gu ru'i tshogs: phrin las mdzad pa cir yang ston: gnas 'dir spyan= tshad med bzhi ldan dkyil 'khor nas: zhi rgyas dbang drag sgo srung bzhi: bka' nyan rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan= gzhan yang bla ma yi dam dang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs: thugs rje'i dbang gis brtser dgongs la: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirma ṇa kā ya: sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru maṇ+ḍa la sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ e h+ye hi: oṃ: sku gsum bla ma bde gshegs tshogs: snying rje'i lcags kyus thugs dam bskul: byams pa'i zhags pas spyan drangs te: dga' ba'i sgrog gis dbyer med bstim: btang snyoms dril bus rab dgyes pa'i: thabs shes zung 'jug phyag rgya che: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med par: lhun grub dkyil 'khor chen por rdzogs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru maṇ+ḍa la sa pā ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: bde chen 'od gsal gzhal med khang : rgyan dang bkod pa bsam mi khyab: rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan khri la: bzhugs nas mchod bzhes dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍal tiṣ+ṭhan+tu: lnga pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni: slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: lha dbang rigs lnga spyan drangs nas: snyoms zhugs byang chub sems kyi chus: spyi bo'i gnas lngar dbang bskur bsam: oṃ: rnam par dag pa'i bdud rtsi yis:

phung po 'byung ba nyon mongs lnga'i: rtog pa'i dri ma rab bsal nas: ye shes lnga ru dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā ā dar+sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā sa ma tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā pra t+ya bek+ṣa ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā kṛ t+ya nuṣ+ṭhā na dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyis chus: lus kyi nang gang bde bas khyab: dbang thob chu lhag gyen du 'khyil: bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rdzogs: drug pa phyag gis 'dud pa ni: rang gi thugs las lha mo'i tshogs: 'jo sgeg yid 'ong rgyan ldan pa: nam mkha' gang ba rab spros nas: phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod par bsam: hoḥ ma bcos spros bral khyab gdal chen po'i dbyings: skye 'gags 'gyur med ye shes yon tan rdzogs: dkyil 'khor gtso bo kun bzang pad+ma 'byung : bla ma chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: rang byung bde chen thugs rje'i rol pa las: sku dang zhing khams bkod pa bsam las 'das: kha sbyor bdag nyid thod phreng rigs mchog lnga: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo: pad sdong las 'khrungs ngo mtshar rgyal ba'i sras: gnas yul kun tu brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzad: mtshan mchog brgyad ldan rigs kyi yum dang rol: bla ma sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: dzaṃ gling bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing khams su: mdo sngags ston pa thub dbang pad+ma 'byung : rigs drug don mdzad rnam 'phrul cir yang ston: 'gro 'dul gu ru'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs kyi sgo bzhi ru: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs: tshad med bzhi ldan khro chen yab dang yum: bka' nyan rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: byin rlabs char 'bebs dngos grub gter gyi mdzod: phrin las thogs med rtsa gsum rab 'byams tshogs:

rnam 'gyur ma nges mdzad pa bsam mi khyab: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti bhū ho: pra tīts+tsha a la la ho: bdun pa mchod pa'i las rim la: phyi mchod nyer spyod kun bzang sprin: nang mchod sgeg sogs phyag rgya gar: gsang ba bde chen ting 'dzin rgyan: rmad byung ngo mtshar glu yis bstod: nyer spyod phyi yi mchod pa ni:

mchod pa 'di rnams gzhung 'dir sa bcad tsam las rgyas par mi snang bas rtsa gsum sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i shog ser las zhal bskangs ba'o/ mchan/ oṃ: kun tu yid 'phrog byams pa'i dbyings: ye shes phyag rgya'i gzugs su shar: rdo rje bdug pa'i dam tshig mchog: bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga dhū pe hūm̐: oṃ: dmigs med snying rje'i sgyu ma'i dbyings: ye shes phyag rgya'i gzugs su shar: rdo rje me tog dam tshig mchog: bzhes nas bdag la= oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga puṣ+pe trām̐: oṃ: kun tu tshim byed dga' ba'i dbyings: ye shes phyag rgya'i gzugs su shar: rdo rje snang gsal dam tshig mchog: bzhes nas bdag la= oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga ā lo ke hrī: oṃ: dmigs med btang snyoms mkha' khyab dbyings: ye shes phyag rgya'i gzugs su shar: rdo rje dri yi dam tshig mchog: bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga gan+dhe ā: ngo mtshar kun bzang mchod sprin ni: oṃ: kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dbyings: ye shes mchod pa'i phyag rgyar shar: nam mkha' mdzod kyi dam tshig mchog: bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā gā ṇā pū dza sa ma ya ho: sgeg sogs nang gi mchod pa ni: oṃ: chos kun stong pa'i 'od gsal dbyings: dga' ba'i ye shes gzugs su snang : rdo rje sgeg ma'i dam tshig mchog: bzhes shig bde ba chen por rol: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga lā s+yai hūm̐: oṃ: shin tu stong pa'i 'od gsal dbyings: mchog dga'i ye shes gzugs su snang : rdo rje phreng ma'i dam tshig mchog: bzhes shig bde ba chen por rol: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga mā le trām̐ḥ oṃ: thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal dbyings: khyad par ye shes gzugs su snang : rdo rje glu ma'i dam tshig mchog: bzhes shig bde ba chen por rol: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga gī tī hrī: oṃ: rab tu stong pa'i 'od gsal dbyings:

lhan skyes ye shes gzugs su snang : rdo rje gar ma'i dam tshig mchog: bzhes shig bde ba chen por rol: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga nīrtā ā: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa ni: lag sor nyi zla 'bru bcus mtshan: rigs lnga yab yum rang bzhin gyis: ji snyed rigs rnams thams cad kun: de nyid rigs lngar bsdus te mchod: oṃ: chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin las: 'gyur med rtag pa'i gzugs su bzhengs: byang chub chen po'i dam tshig gis: bde gshegs rigs mchog mnyes gyur cig: oṃ bud+dha sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā mu dra pū dza ho: ā:sor rtog ye shes rang bzhin las: 'gags med chos kyi gzugs su bzhengs: ting nge 'dzin chen po'i dam tshig gis: pad+ma'i rigs mchog mnyes gyur cig: oṃ pad+ma sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā mu dra pū dza ho: hūm̐: me long ye shes rang bzhin las: mi bskyod rgyal po'i gzugs su bzhengs: bdud 'dul chen po'i dam tshig gis: rdo rje'i rigs mchog mnyes gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā mu drā pū dza ho: swa: mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin las: gzi brjid snang ba'i gzugs su bzhengs: mchog sbyin chen po'i dam tshig gis: rin chen rigs mchog mnyes gyur cig: oṃ rat+na sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pū dza hoḥ hā: bya grub ye shes rang bzhin las: kun tu thogs med gzugs su bzhengs: skyabs sbyin chen po'i dam tshig gis: las kyi rigs mchog mnyes gyur cig: oṃ karma sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā mu drā pū dza hoḥ lām̐ gyi ye shes rol pa las: rdo rje spyan ma'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: mi 'gyur rtag pa'i dam tshig gis: bde gshegs btsun mo dgyes gyur cig: oṃ bud+dha ma hā mu dra pū dza hoḥ pyām̐ gi ye shes rol pa las: rdo rje gos dkar phyag rgyar bzhengs: bde chen chu skyes dam tshigs gis: pad+ma'i btsun mo dgyes gyur cig: oṃ pad+ma ma hā mu drā pū dza hoḥ muṃ gyi ye shes rol pa las:

rdo rje dbyings phyug phyag rgyar bzhengs: mi phyed 'od gsal dam tshig gis: rdo rje'i btsun mo dgyes gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra ma hā mu drā pū dza ho: mām̐ gyi ye shes rol pa las: rdo rje mā kī'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: ye shes nyi ma'i dam tshig gis: rin chen btsun mo dgyes gyur cig: oṃ rat+na ma hā mu drā pū dza ho: tām̐ gyi ye shes rol pa las: rdo rje sgrol ma'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: kun tu 'jug pa'i dam tshig gis: las kyi btsun mo dgyes gyur cig: oṃ karma ma hā mu drā pū dza ho: bde chen gsang ba'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐ āḥ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal rmad byung ba: pad+ma can sogs lha mo'i tshogs: 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang tsum+ba nas: lha rnams bde ba'i gnas la bskul: 'khyud dang snyoms zhugs gsor zhing bskyod: byang chub sems sprin rab tu dbab: mkha' dbyings snying po'i ti la kar: til gyi gong bu bzhin gang ba'i: bsam yas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo kun: dga' bzhi ye shes dbyings su sbyor: nyon mongs bde chen thig ler bsgral: zung 'jug bde ba'i gnas la rol: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga ma hā su kha dz+nyā na pū dza ho: lhag pa ting 'dzin mchod pa ni: oṃ: oṃ gyi ting 'dzin las byung ba: rin chen sa gzhi gzhal med khang : ngo mtshar dpag yas mchod sprin gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga rat+na bi mā na pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: hūm̐ gi ting 'dzin las byung ba: yid 'phrog lha dang lha mo'i tshogs: ye shes sgyu ma'i mchod sprin gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga pū dza karma ku ru hoḥ āḥ āḥyi ting 'dzin las byung ba: glu dbyangs rol mo snyan pa'i sgra: kun tu tshim byed mchod sprin gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga shab+da pū dza hoḥ trām̐: trām̐ gi ting 'dzin las byung ba: lha rdzas na bza' rin chen rgyan:

longs spyod mchog gi mchod sprin gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga wās+t+ra a laṃ ka ra pū dza hoḥ āḥyi ting 'dzin las byung ba: bza' bca' btung ba yang dag ldan: ro bcud nus pa'i mchod sprin gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga nai bid+yā pū dza hoḥ khyad par rmad byung mchod sprin ni: oṃ: snang srid gdod nas bdud rtsi lnga: ma bcos ma bslad de bzhin gshegs: rigs lnga yab yum snyoms zhugs pa'i: byang chub sems kyi bde ba'i rgyun: lcags kyu lnga dang sgron ma lnga: rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong : mnyam par sbyar ba'i dam tshig rdzas: rā sa yā na sman chen po: mtshan ldan bhan+dha'i snod du bskyil: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod la: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi ho: āḥ khams gsum gdug pa ma lus kun: snying rje khros pa'i shugs kyis bkug: 'od gsal rdo rje'i mtshon chas bsgral: nyon mongs rang dag dmar chen po: mkha' dbyings bde ba'i ye shes rgyun: so sor rtog pa'i rba rlabs g.yo: gnyis su med par mnyam sbyar ba'i: brtul zhugs mchog gi dam tshig rdzas: lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+dhar bskyil: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: mthu rtsal nus pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ ma hā rak+ta pū dza khā hi: dz+nyā na dz+wa la sid+dhi hoḥ hūm̐ḥ rin chen pad+ma bhañdza'i snod: stong gsum 'jig rten khyon yangs par: sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga: bcud kyi sems can gtor mar sbyar: brjid ldan lhun po lta bur spungs: rdo rje gsum gyis byin brlabs pas: kha dog dri ro nus par ldan: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro: rak+ta bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pa'i: longs spyod mchog gi mchod pa 'di:

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: bde chen ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: ma hā su kha dz+nyā na sid+dhi hoḥ bstod dbyangs glu yi mchod pa ni: yid 'phrog lha mo'i tshogs rnams kyis: rdo rje rkang lag mdzes pa'i gar: bdun ldan glu dang rab sbyar nas: ye shes drug gis bstod par bsam: oṃ: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin gzi brjid chen por snang : thugs rje mtshan dpe'i dpal du 'bar: rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: āḥ sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin sgra brnyan lta bu'i tshul: thugs rjes chos kyi char chen 'bebs: rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin spros pa kun las 'das: thugs rje'i rig rtsal cir yang 'char: rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: swā: mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin 'dod 'byung yid bzhin gter: thugs rjes gdul bya'i re ba skong : yon tan rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod: hā: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin thogs med lhun gyis grub: thugs rje'i mdzad pa bsam mi khyab: phrin las rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod: ho: 'od gsal ye shes ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin khyab gdal byang chub sems: thugs rje sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bdag: ye shes rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti dz+nyā na gī ti pū dza ho: bsam yas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi: ye shes drug gi bstod pa'i glu: lan cig tsam zhig blangs pas kyang : dngos grub thams cad 'thob par 'gyur: brgyad pa dzab kyi dgongs pa ni: oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa dzaḥ bdag nyid dam tshig 'khor lo las: ye shes gnyis pa mdun du bye: me ri 'dabs 'byor tshul nyid du: gsal zhing brtan par bzhugs pa yi: thugs srog sa bon sngags kyis mtshan: lha tshogs gzi brjid 'od tu 'bar:

snying po sngags kyi nus stobs rdzogs: ting 'dzin dgongs pas byin brlabs bsam: hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma sku gsum lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dgyes pa'i gar sgyur sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs: ting 'dzin dgongs rgyud dag pas byin rlobs la: ye shes rol pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: zhes bskul bla ma chos kyi sku'i: ting 'dzin srog bzung bsnyen pa ni: dkyil 'khor gtso bo pad+ma kun tu 'chang : rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chen po'i thugs ka ru: rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing gsal: mtha' skor sngags phreng rang sgra dang bcas 'khod: rtse gcig gsal btab ting 'dzin srog bzung nas: rlung yid sems dang rig pa gcig tu dril: mi 'gyur snying po dzab kyi rgyun bskul bas: khyab gdal dgongs pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: 'bum phrag bcu gnyis bzlas pa yis: chos sku'i ye shes rgyud la smin: longs sku thod phreng rigs lnga la: brten nas bsnyen pa'i nye bsnyen ni: thod phreng rigs lnga'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng : hūm̐ oṃ tram̐ hrīḥ.āḥyig sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas sngags phreng lu gu rgyud du 'phros: yab yum zhal brgyud gsang ba'i sbubs su zhugs: bar med 'khor bas mi 'gyur bde chen chen rgyas: phung po 'byung ba nyon mongs rtog tshogs sbyangs: sku lngas byin brlabs rigs lnga'i dngos grub thob: ye shes lnga yi dgongs pa mngon du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru badz+ra thod phreng rtsal sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru bud+dha thod phreng rtsal sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru rat+na thod rtsal sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ o+oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru karma thod phreng rtsal sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas bde ba che'i:

ye shes rig rtsal rgyas par 'gyur: sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad la: brten nas bsnyen pa'i sgrub pa ni: sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad thugs ka ru: nyi zla kha sbyor hrīḥmathar sngags kyis mtshan: bzlas pas rgyud bskul rigs kyi 'od zer 'phros: 'khor 'das snod bcud brtan g.yo'i khams kun khyab: bde stong rtsal 'bar mkhyen gnyis snang ba rgyas: khams gsum dbang bsdus bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs bcom: 'gro kun smin grol ye shes yon tan 'phel: bdud dang mu stegs dam sri 'byung po btul: 'od zer tshul 'dus bdag la thim pa yis: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ma hā su kha sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ma hā rā dza sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma shākya siṃ ha sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma yo ge shwa ra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha wa sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma siṃ ha gaṇ+ḍa sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐badz+ra gu ru pad+ma gro bo lod lo ka sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: 'bum phrag bzlas pas dngos grub thob: 'gro 'dul bde gshegs rig 'dzin la: brten nas bsnyen pa'i sgrub chen ni: spyi dang khyad par thun mong las: rjes 'brel dang bcas bzlas pas bsgrub: thog mar bde gshegs rig 'dzin spyi'i: dzab kyi dgongs pa'i 'phro 'du ni: bde gshegs bla ma rnams kyi thugs ka ru: zla steng hūm̐ dang hrīḥyig sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas rgyud bskul ye shes gzi byin 'bar: sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan 'od zer tshogs: mi mjed 'jig rten rab 'byams kun tu 'phros: sangs rgyas byang chub mdzad pa mtha' yas pas: snod kyi zhing sbyong 'og min bkod par rdzogs:

bcud kyi 'gro kun sgrib gnyis bag chags dag: gzugs snang lha la sgrar grags sngags kyi dbyangs: rtog tshogs 'od gsal gnyug ma'i dbyings su thim: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa rab 'byams dang : 'gro 'dul bde gshegs phrin las mthar phyin bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas 'gro 'dul gyi: ye shes nus pa rgyud la 'char: khyad par rigs drug gu ru yi: 'khor ba dong sprugs dgongs pa ni: gu ru drug gi thugs srog sa bon las: sngags phreng 'phro 'du'i 'od zer snang ba yis: bdag gzhan khams gsum rigs drug kun la khyab: nyon mongs drug gi rgyu 'bras sdug bsngal sbyangs: rang byung ye shes drug gis byin brlabs pas: snod bcud gu ru drug gi zhing du dag: lha sngags ye shes khyab gdal dgongs pa'i klong : 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las mthar phyin bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ rat+na gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ karma gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dz+nyā na gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bud+dha gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ pad+ma gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dang so so'i sngags sham du: bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba su ra ga te he tūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: tra ṭ tra ṭ sarba a su ra ga te he tūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da sarba ṇṛ ga te he tūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: rtsa sngags 'bum dang las sngags khri: ting 'dzin rtse gcig bzlas pa yis: rigs drug 'khor ba'i 'brel rgyun chod: ye shes drug gi rtogs pa skye: 'brel tshad don dang ldan par 'gyur: thun mong las bzhi'i bzlas pa ni: khro chen bzhi yi thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐:

sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis: bka' nyan rgya mtsho'i rgyud bskul sprul pa dang : dkar ser dmar mthing 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: mi mthun kun zhi legs tshogs yon tan rgyas: khams gsum dbang bsdus dgra bgegs 'byung po bsgral: tshur 'dus bdag thim byin rlabs nus stobs 'bar: rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par bsam: oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya dza:hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: oṃ rat+na kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: bh+rūm̐ paṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: oṃ pad+ma kro dha ha ya grī wa bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: hrīḥwā shaṃ ku ru ho: oṃ karma kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī hoḥhūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭa: khri phrag bzhi 'am zhag bdun bzla: las kyi dngos grub gang 'dod 'grub: rjes 'brel rtsa gsum rab 'byams lha: bsnyen pas thugs dam bskul ba ni: bzlas brjod sngags kyi 'phro 'du'i rol pa yis: rab 'byams rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed: lha sngags ye shes 'od zer bdag la thim: byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las dpal du 'bar: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ badz+ra gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba sid+dh-i pha la hūm̐ ā: spyi dril 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas pas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi: byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las kyis: 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par 'gyur: dgu pa bstod cing bskul ba ni: dang po mchod pas dgyes pa bskyed: bar du bstod pas mnga' dbul zhing : mthar ni bskul bas phrin las gsol: dam ye dbyer med nga rgyal brtan: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos su 'byor dang yid las byung ba yi: me tog bdug spos mar me dri zhim chab: kun bzang rol mo nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter: rdo rje sgeg phreng glu dang gar mkhan ma: ye shes lnga yi phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan: yab yum mnyam sbyor zag med bde ba che: ting 'dzin bkod pa'i bye brag bsam mi khyab: rmad byung sman raka gtor ma 'dod yon rgyan:

bstod dbyangs ye shes sku yi mchod sprin tshogs: rang byung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dgyes bzhes dam tshig nyams chag dbyings su bskang : byin rlobs mchog thun phrin las dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba pū dza me gha sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la ho: hūm̐ hrī: yid chos gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa dbyings su dag: ma bcos spros med ye shes snying po brnyes: dkyil 'khor khyab bdag pad+ma kun tu 'chang : bla ma chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam shes rnam dag me long ye shes sku: kha sbyor bde ba'i longs spyod chen por rol: rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzugs phung rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes sku: kha sbyor bde ba'i longs spyod chen por rol: bde gshegs rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso: bud+dha thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshor ba rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes sku: kha sbyor bde ba'i longs spyod chen por rol: rin chen rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag: rat+na thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'du shes rnam dag sor rtog ye shes sku: kha sbyor bde ba'i longs spyod chen por rol: pad+ma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'du byed rnam dag bya grub ye shes sku: kha sbyor bde ba'i longs spyod chen por rol: las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag: karma thod phreng rtsal la= nyon yid rnam shes ma spangs dbyings su grol: chags med skyon bral bde chen pad+ma 'byung : ma 'ongs rtog tshogs dag pa'i ḍā ki nī: yab yum gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal= kun gzhi'i rnam shes ma spangs dbyings su grol: shes bya kun mkhyen blo ldan mchog sred rtsal: ma nges rtog tshogs dag pa'i rnal 'byor ma:

yab yum gnyis su med la phyag= sna yi rnam shes ma spangs dbyings su grol: khams gsum dbang sdud gu ru pad+ma'i rgyal: sgrar snang rtog tshogs dag pa'i 'od 'chang ma: yab yum gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal= yid kyi rnam shes ma spangs dbyings su grol: bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad thub chen shākya siṃ: da lta'i rtog tshogs dag pa'i zhi ba 'tsho: yab yum gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal bstod: rna ba'i rnam shes ma spangs dbyings su grol: brtul zhugs spyod 'chang 'gro 'dul nyi ma 'od: drir snang rtog tshogs dag pa'i bdag med ma: yab yum gnyis su med la= lus kyi rnam shes ma spangs dbyings su grol: yon tan lhun rdzogs pad+ma saṃ bha wa: 'das dus rtog tshogs dag pa'i bde ba 'dzin: yab yum gnyis su med la phyag= lce yi rnam shes ma spangs dbyings su grol: mu stegs 'dul mdzad seng ge sgra sgrogs rtsal: ro snang rtog tshogs dag pa'i bdud 'dul ma: yab yum gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal lo: mig gi rnam shes ma spangs dbyings su grol: dregs pa tshar gcod rdo rje gro bo lod: gzugs snang rtog tshogs dag pa'i phra men ma: yab yum gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum rtog tshogs rnam dag ye shes rtsal: sku gsum dbyer med thub dbang pad+ma 'byung : khams gsum mi mjed 'jig rten 'gro ba 'dul: bde gshegs rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: nyon mongs drug dag ye shes sku mchog brnyes: pha rol phyin drug spyod pa rlabs chen rdzogs: rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dong nas sprugs: 'gro 'dul gu ru drug la phyag 'tshal bstod: lus kyi chos bzhi rnam dag khro chen bzhi: rtag chad bdag mtshan dag pa'i yum dang sbyor: zhi rgyas dbang drag rnam 'phrul cir yang ston: bka' nyan lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: snang srid gzung 'dzin rnam dag ye shes rtsal: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'khrigs:

byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las bsam mi khyab: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: khyab gdal chos dbyings chen po las: mi gnas ye shes sgyu ma'i tshul: sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje thugs dam dus la bab: hūm̐: 'od gsal chos sku'i zhing khams nas: rang byung pad+ma kun tu 'chang : rigs kyi gtso bo sku bzhengs shig: dgongs klong mngon gyur phrin las mdzod: mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas: mi 'gyur rigs rnams kun gyi bdag: rdo rje thod phreng sku bzhengs shig: me long rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams nas: khyab gdal rigs rnams kun gyi bdag: bud+dha thod phreng sku bzhengs shig: chos dbyings rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: dpal ldan brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nas: 'dod 'byung rigs rnams kun gyi bdag: rat+na thod phreng sku bzhengs shig: mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzad: pad+ma brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nas: chags med rigs rnams kun gyi bdag: pad+ma thod phreng sku bzhengs shig: sor rtog rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: las rab brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nas: thogs med rigs rnams kun gyi bdag: karma thod phreng sku bzhengs shig: bya grub rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho gling du: 'chi med mchog brnyes pad+ma 'byung : rigs gyi yum bcas dus la bab: gzung 'dzin zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: rā ga rak+ta'i gnas mchog tu: shes bya kun mkhyen mchog sred rtsal: rigs kyi yum bcas dus la bab: ye shes rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: 'khor 'das dbang sgyur pad+ma'i rgyal: rigs kyi yum bcas dus la bab: khams gsum dbang sdud phrin las mdzod: za hor rgyal po'i yul khams su: drag po'i rtsal rdzogs shākya siṃ: rigs kyi yum bcas dus ba bab: bdud bzhi tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: so sa gling gi dur khrod du:

brtul zhugs spyod 'chang nyi ma 'od: rigs kyi yum bcas dus la bab: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: dngos grub mchog brnyes saṃ bha wa: rigs kyi yum bcas dus la bab: yon tan rtsal rdzogs phrin las mdzod: ma ga dhā yi yul dbus su: mu stegs bdud 'dul seng ge'i sgra: rigs kyi yum bcas dus la bab: log lta tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: stag tshang seng ge'i ke'u tshang du: dregs pa zil gnon gro bo lod: rigs kyi yum bcas dus la bab: mngon spyod rol pa'i phrin las mdzod: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas: dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas dang : rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dus la bab: 'gro 'dul rtsal rdzogs phrin las mdzod: rigs drug sprul sku'i zhing khams nas: khams gsum dbugs 'byin gu ru drug: rnam 'phrul bsam yas dus la bab: 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las mdzod: tshad med bzhi ldan pho brang nas: rigs bzhi'i khro chen yum dang bcas: bka' nyan rgya mtsho'i dus la bab: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las mdzod: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin bla ma yi dam lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dus la bab: byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐: yul gyi ming gi rnga yab gling : zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i rtse: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: srin po'i rgyal po yal gam can: rak+sha thod phreng sku bzhengs shig: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bdag cag bod khams snyigs ma'i 'gro: mi 'dod sdug bsngal du mas mnar: nad mug mtshon gyi bskal ngan langs: mtha' dmag gdug pas skabs btsal tshe: khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas: thugs rje thugs dam dus la bab: mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad sol: mthun rkyen tshe bsod nyams rtogs spor: khams gsum snod bcud dbang du sdus: log lta'i 'byung po choms la phob:

'dod chags rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dal zlog: zhe sdang rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i: dus 'khrugs mtshon char 'bebs pa zlog: gti mug rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i: phyi nang 'byung ba'i g.yo 'khrugs zlog: nga rgyal rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i: sde brgyad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul zlog: phrag dog rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i: byad kha phur kha rbod gtong zlog: ser sna'i rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i: bkres skom mu ge'i skal ngan zlog: the tshom rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i: sha za 'byung po'i 'tshe ba zlog: log lta'i rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i: mtha' dmag kla klo'i 'tshubs 'gyur zlog: ma rig rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i: lugs 'byung 'khor ba'i bag chags kun: lugs ldog mya ngan 'das pa'i dbyings: 'khor 'das dbyer med chen por zlog: sarba sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog: de ltar gnad nas bskul ba las: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi: mdzad pa cho 'phrul bsam yas pas: gang 'dul phrin las lhun rdzogs bsam: mthar ni mdun gyi ye shes pa: dam tshig 'khor lor dbyer med bstim: oṃ: ye shes dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha: ting 'dzin sprul pa'i phyag rgyar thim: rdo rje'i dam tshig rmad po che: mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs shig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dz+nyā na kā ya wā ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma badz+ra sa ma ya a ā: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+wam̐: g.yo med dgongs pa'i srog bzung nas: ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyangs pas: rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun grub cing : rig pa 'dzin pa'i sku thob 'gyur: bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig las: sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi'i las rim bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o: sa ma ya: gsum pa rjes kyi las rim la: dang po tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: gcan gzan pags pa'i gdan la sogs: rngams shing brjid ldan stegs bu'i steng : sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bcas pa'i:

ma da na dang bā la sogs: bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs rnams dang : mchod pa'i bye brag bkod mdzes bsham: me rlung chu yis bsang byas la: yi ge gsum gyis stong par sbyang : hūm̐: ye shes tshogs la mtshan rtog ma mchis kyang : dngos bshams rdzas kyi gzung 'dzin sbyang ba'i phyir: gnyis med rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos kun sgyu mar rig pa'i rang gdangs rtsal: ram̐ las lhag mthong me yis bag chags bsregs: yam̐ las rig rtsal rlung gis gnyis snang gtor: kham̐ las zhi gnas chu yis dag par bkrus: snod bcud stong gsal dbyings kyi thig ler 'khyil: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: yi ge drug gis byin gyis brlab: slar yang ye shes drug gi rol pa'i rtsal: oṃ las 'od 'phros pad+ma bhañdza'i snod: yangs shing rgya che stong gsum mnyam pa'i dbus: āḥlas 'od 'phros sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: rigs lnga yab yum byang sems rgya mtshor bskyil: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros gzugs sgra dri ro reg: zag med 'dod yon phung po sprin ltar 'phro: ha hoḥhrīḥyi ge'i 'phro 'du las: kha dog dri ro nus pa rmad byung ba'i: bcud ldan zag med tshogs kyi longs spyod che: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa skong ba'i rdzas: 'phel 'grib med pa dbyings kyi rgyan du shar: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥde nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings lhun rdzogs zhing khams nas: dkyil 'khor khyab bdag pad+ma kun tu 'chang : rang snang ye shes rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing khams nas: kha sbyor bde ba'i bdag nyid thod phreng rtsal: rigs lnga tshom bu 'bum sde'i 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags rang shar sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin mtshan mchog brgyad: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas:

'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: phyogs bcu'i mi mjed rab 'byams zhing khams nas: mdo sngags ston mchog thub dbang pad+ma 'byung : bde gshegs rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gang 'dul 'gro drug sprul sku'i zhing khams nas: ye shes mchog gi rol pa gu ru drug: sgyu 'phrul bkod pa bsam yas 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rnam bzhi'i phrin las rdzogs pa'i zhing khams nas: tshar gcod rjes 'dzin khro bo chen po bzhi: rigs kyi yum mchog bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: snang srid rnam dag ye shes dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha: dpa' bo ḍā ki rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: tshogs khang rang byung 'og min gsang ba'i zhing : rnal 'byor 'dus pa rig 'dzin tshogs kyi rje: 'dod yon mchod sprin kun bzang rol pa'i rgyan: lha sngags ye shes chen por byin phob cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dharma kā ya: saṃ bho ga kā ya: nirmā ṇa kā ya sarba maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wā ra e h+ye hi: badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: de ltar rab 'byams tshogs kyi zhing : mkha' khyab 'khor lor sad pa la: phyi nang mchod pa sngon 'gro bas: 'dod yon tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ tshogs kyi ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga: gdod nas rnam dag byang chub sems kyi bcud: rang bzhin sha lnga bdud rtsi chen po lnga: bza' bca' btung ba rdo rje'i dam tshig rdzas: rnam pa 'dod yon zag med bde chen sprin: rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis: sku gsum bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod: yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung dgyes par rol: rang byung bde stong rol pa'i gzi byen skyed:

zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las 'grub pa dang : bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sarba maṇ+ḍa la sa pā ri wa ra ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ bar pas dam tshig nyams chag bshags: hoḥ ye nas gnyis med mnyam pa chen po la: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dri ma las 'das kyang : ma rig dbang gyur bdag lus ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis sdig pa'i las mang bgyis: sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla: tha ma bsgral zhing bstab pa ni: sgo skyong tshogs las pho nya spros: gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs kun: mtshan ma'i rten la 'gug gzhug bcing : bsgral zhing zhal du bstabs par bsam: hūm̐: bka' nyan khro bo'i tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: pho nya las mkhan sprul pas stong gsum khengs: byang chub sgrub la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs kun: dgug gzhug bcing myos mtshan ma'i rten la stims: ye shes 'bar ba'i phur bus snying gar gzir: tshe bsod dwangs ma sgrub mchog rnams la stsol: rnam shes kun bzang bla ma'i sras su bskyed: sha khrag gzugs phung rdul phran bzhin du gtubs: dam tshig mchog gi bdud rtsi'i rdzas su bsgyur: rig 'dzin khros pa'i lha tshogs zhal du stob: drag shul rjes chags rol pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: sbyor sgrol mchog gi phrin las yongs rdzogs mdzod: e nṛ tri sarba sha trūn bigh+nān dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ karma kī li kī la ya bhin+da ya bhin+da ya saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: mā ra ya rbad: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti badz+ra sa ma ya pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: slar yang thugs dam skong ba yi: las rim gzhan yang ci rigs bya: de nas dam tshig longs spyod tshogs: brda yis dbul zhing lan gyis blang :

snang stong bde chen ngang du rol: lus dkyil dbang yul lha tshogs rnams: zag med bde bas dgyes pa las: dngos grub chen po thob par bsam: drod thob gsang ba'i spyod pa dang : rdo rje'i glu dang gar sogs kyis: bde stong nyams myong gong du spel: mthar ni gdung bas smon lam gdab: ho: sku gsum yongs rdzogs bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa phul ba yis: bdag gzhan 'gro kun tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur thob shog: lha tshogs mnyes shing dam tshig nyams chags bskangs: phung khams skye mched zag med bde bas tshim: bde chen gsang ba'i spyod pa la brten nas: ye shes phyag rgya tshe 'dir 'grub par shog: mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe mdzad phrin 'phel: 'jig rten khams kun nad mug mtshon 'khrugs zhi: rtag tu bde skyid dpal gnas bkra shis shog: gnyis pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni: bdud rtsis bsang zhing byin gyis brlab: lhag mgron spyan drangs dam rdzas 'bul: phrin las gsol zhing gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ e a ral+li hriṃ hriṃ pheṃ pheṃ: hūm̐: bla ma sku gsum rab 'byams lha tshogs kyi: dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i mu ran skyong ba yi: ma mo mkha' 'gro zhing skyong ltag sdud tshogs: glog ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis 'dir gshegs shig: dpal gyi pham phab bza' bca' bdung ba'i rdzas: ri ltar spungs shing rgya mtsho lta bur bskyil: 'dod yon sprin phung mkha' dbyings kun khyab pa'i: ye shes rol pa tshogs kyi lhag ma bzhes: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'dus par bcas pa yi: 'khor rnams srung zhing 'gal rkyen thams cad zlog: sdang ba'i dgra thul gnod pa'i bgegs tshogs choms: rnam bzhi'i las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta kha kha kha hi khā hiḥ yā hi gats+tsha: gsum pa tha tshig bsgrag pa ni:

dmar gtor sha khrag rgyan ldan pa: byin gyis brlab cing 'bul ba dang : sngon gyi tha tshig phrin las bskul: hūm̐ hrī: sngon tshe 'od gsal snying po'i pho brang du: chos sku bla ma kun tu 'chang chen pos: rig rtsal rol pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho la: dgongs klong ro gcig chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe: bla med sa la mngon par byang chub nas: mkha' khyab 'gro kun sgrol bar zhal bzhes ltar: ye shes rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la: rang byung bkod pa bsam yas zhing khams su: bla ma longs sku thod phreng rigs lnga yis: rang rang rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum sde la: rdo rje sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe: brgyud 'dzin smin grol 'god par zhal bzhes ltar: zag med nyams myong mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bde stong rig rtsal rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: de rjes 'gro don gdul bya'i dus bab tshe: dzaṃ gling mi mjed zhing khams rab 'byams su: bla ma sprul sku bde gshegs rig 'dzin gyis: gnas yul mkha' 'gro snod ldan 'dus pa la: gang 'dul chos bstan brtul zhugs spyod pa'i tshe: rnal 'byor sgrub mchog skyong bar zhal bzhes ltar: 'dod yon rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: snang sems dbang du 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod: da lta snyigs ma shin tu gdul dka'i dus: smon lam las sad chos kyi pho brang du: sku gsum dbyer med pad+ma thod phreng gis: bka' babs bdun ldan sprul pa'i rig 'dzin la: dbang bskur byin brlabs gdams pa gtad pa'i tshe: ye shes las grub chos srung rgya mtsho yis: zab gter bstan pa skyong ba zhal bzhes ltar: sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: gnyis snang dgra bgegs tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: sku gsum bla ma'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes kun: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes:

rnal 'byor 'khor srungs rkyen zlog bar chad sol: mchog thun phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod: oṃ sarba dz+nyā na lo ka d+dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ai daṃ ba liṃ ta pū dza khā hiḥ sarba karma sa ma ya ku+u ru ho: bzhi pa bshal chu'i bdud rtsi yis: bod khams brtan ma bskyang ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: bod khams 'jig rten skyong ba'i g.yar dam can: bdud dang gnod sbyin sman mo mched sde bzhi: bstan skyong ya ma 'bum phrag 'khor bcas kun: tshur gshegs dam skong bshal chu'i gtor la longs: pad+ma thod phreng spyan sngar zhal bzhes ltar: mtha' dmag mu stegs kla klo'i so kha srungs: gangs can mtha' dbus kun tu bde ba dang : mdo sngags bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba ma ma ḍā ki nī ba liṃ ta khā hi: yā hi gats+tsha: lnga pa rta brau brdung ba ni: hūm̐: 'bar ba e dbyings tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: dam sri 'byung po dpung bcas bkug cing bstim: rdo rje lhun po ri rab 'og tu mnan: sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan bro brdungs pas: zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi lhun gyis grub: thar pa'i gegs byed bdag 'dzin ru tra kun: byang chub mchog sems ma skyes bar srid du: mnan pa yin no ldang bar ma byed cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ s+t+wam+bha ya lam̐ nan: drug pa dngos grub gsol ba ni: mchod cing bstod pa sngon 'gro bas: dam tshig rdzas la brten nas kyang : dus dang rgyun gyi dngos grub blang : oṃ āḥhūm̐: nyer spyod kun bzang 'dod yon phyag rgya gar: bde chen ting 'dzin rmad byung bstod pa'i dbyangs: sku gsum bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: mchod bzhes dam skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pū dza pra tits+tsha ho: pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje:

pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen mchog tu mi 'gyur chos kyi dbyings: kha sbyor bde ba'i longs spyod chen por rdzogs: nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sprul pa bsam mi khyab: sku gsum bla ma bde gshegs rig 'dzin tshogs: sgrub la dngos grub stsol ba'i thugs dam can: dang por mos shing gdung bas mchod cing bsnyen: bar du bskyed rdzogs dbyer med ting 'dzin bsgrubs: da ltar dngos grub gsol ba'i dus lags na: bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam nor bu ltar: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dkyil 'khor nas: bde chen rdo rje'i byin phob dbang mchog bskur: 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: mi zad rgyan gyi byin phob= 'gags med gsung gi dngos= ye shes rdo rje'i byin phob= 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos= lhun grub bter gyis byin phob= yon tan re skong dngos= mthu rtsal nus pa'i byin phob= phrin las 'gro 'dul dngos= 'khor 'das dwangs bcud byin phob: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub= 'dod 'byung dpal gyi byin phob= 'dzad med nor gyi dngos= rnam bzhi'i las kyi byin phob dbang mchog skur: thun mong yid bzhin dngos grub stsal du= ye shes chen po'i byin phob dbang mchog skur: bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du= oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ṇa sid+dhi trām̐: karma sid+dhi hāḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes brjod dngos grub rten rnams kun: gnas lngar gtugs shing dam rdzas myang : mchog thun ye shes mngon gyur bsam: rjes 'brel nongs tshogs bzod par gsol: hoḥ bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang gis: mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor nyams pa dang : cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chags kun: snying nas bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol:

yi ge brgya pa ci mang bzla: bdun pa mtha' gnyis bsal ba ni: āḥ snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lha: mkha' dbyings sprin bzhin rang la thim: de yang mi dmigs rdzogs pa che: ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag: sa ma ya dz+nyā na dhā tu a a: hūm̐: slar yang mkha' las 'ja' shar ltar: rang nyid pad+ma kun tu 'chang : rdo rje gsum gyi srog ldan pas: cir snang ye shes rol par spyod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru dharma kā ya badz+ra dz+nyā na sa ma ya ho: brgyad pa bsngo smon bya ba ni: ho: dge ba 'di yis bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin zhing : rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i go 'phang myur 'grub nas: nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can ma lus kun: sku gsum bla ma'i sa la 'god par shogaḥ dgu pa bkra shis brjod pa ni: oṃ: bkra shis gang zhig 'od gsal snying po'i dbyings: sku dang ye shes yon tan 'du 'bral med: chos sku'i bdag nyid pad+ma kun tu 'chang : bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: bkra shis gang zhig bde chen rol pa las: bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor spro: longs sku'i gtso mchog rigs lnga thod phreng rtsal: bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde bde legs shog: bkra shis gang zhig phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su: brtul zhugs spyod mdzad mdo sngags chos char 'bebs: sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad bde gshegs rig 'dzin tshogs: bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: bkra shis gang zhig dpag bsam shing chen dang : bum pa bzang dang yid bzhin nor bu ltar: thun mong phrin las rtsol med lhun gyis grub: bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: bkra shis gang zhig skal bzang 'dus pa'i tshogs: bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin brtan: ye shes mchog brnyes mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad: bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: ces brjod me tog phyogs bcur 'thor: rol mo snyan cing brjid par 'khrol:

thun mtshams lha sngags bde chen ngang : rtag tu dge ba'i las la brtson: de ltar cho ga'i rim pa 'dis: bsod nams tshogs chen gong du 'phel: ye shes nyams rtogs rtsol med 'char: mchog thun dngos grub rgyas par 'gyur: bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig las: sgrub pa'i rjes kyi las rim bstan pa'i le'u lnga pa'o: sa ma ya: de ltar rgyas par bshad pa yi: sgrub pa'i snying po mdor bsdus pa: thog mar spros med rnal 'byor gyi: bskyed rim zab mo'i phrin las ni: dad dang nges shes rtse gcig pas: sbyor dngos rjes kyis nyams su blang : na mo: rig pa rang shar sku gsum lha tshogs la: gnyis med khyab gdal ngang nas skyabs su mchi: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir: zab gsang snying po bsgrub par sems bskyed do: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ngang gis khros pa'i rang rtsal gyis: gnyis snang bgegs tshogs rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrad: ye shes mtshon cha me phung khro tshogs bcas: gzhom med rdo rje'i srung 'khor lhun gyis grub: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: badz+ra dz+wa la kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs rig 'dzin tshogs: dbyings nas brtser dgongs ye shes byin chen phob: snod bcud bkod pa lhun rdzogs 'dod yon sprin: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra dz+nyā na ā be sha a āḥ hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: oṃ sarba ma hā pū dza mu dra sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ḥ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ: aḥ de bzhin nyid dbyings stong gsal chos kyi sku: kun snang ye shes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sprin: zung 'jug sprul sku rgyu yi 'od zer gyis: gzung 'dzin dngos kun stong pa chen po'i ngang : yul snang thams cad 'og min gsang ba'i zhing : rdo rje'i srung 'khor dur khrod bkod pa'i dbus: rang byung lhun grub lus kyi gzhal med khang :

ye shes yon tan rab rdzogs gzi byin 'bar: lte bar chu skyes nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng : yid chos rnam dag pad+ma kun tu 'chang : bde ba'i bdag nyid nam mkha' dwangs ma'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum spyan gsum g.yo: thabs shes zung 'jug rdor dril thugs kar bsnol: gnyis med sbyor yum stong chen dbyings phyug ma: dkar gsal rdo rje dril 'dzin yab dang 'khyud: gnyis ka dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: ye shes 'od zer bsam yas 'phro 'du'i klong : rdo rje pad+ma'i skyil krung rol pa yis: lhan skyes bde chen mchog gi gzi byin 'bar: dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag nyid chen por gsal: hūm̐: rigs kun khyab bdag chen po'i sku yi dbyings: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan grong khyer dbus: phung po 'byung ba rnam dag thod phreng lnga: kha spyor bde ba'i longs spyod chen por rdzogs: rnam shes rgyu ba'i dbang po'i thig le ru: tshogs brgyad gzung 'dzin gnas su dag pa'i rtsal: sprul pa'i skur snang mtshan mchog rnam par brgyad: rigs kyi yum bcas gzi byin lam mer bzhugs: lnga ldan 'khor lo'i phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcur: rtog tshogs rang grol thub dbang pad+ma 'byung : sku gsum thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: bde gshegs rig 'dzin tshom bu'i 'khor gyis bskor: khams gsum dag pa las kyi gnas drug tu: nyon mongs rnam dag 'gro 'dul gu ru drug: yan lag tshigs mtshams lus kyi chos bzhi dang : lta ba dag pa khro chen yum dang bcas: gzhan yang steng 'og bar mtshams thams cad du: snang srid rnam dag rtsa gsum rab 'byams lha: sku mdog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur cir yang ston: mdangs gsal ma 'gags 'od skur lam mer gsal: hūm̐: de ltar gsal ba'i phyi nang lha tshogs kyi: gnas gsum mi phyed rdo rje sku gsung thugs: yi ge gsum mtshan 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis: mkha' khyab ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs bsam:

hūm̐ hrīḥ don dam dbyings la gshegs bzhugs ma dmigs kyang : kun 'byung gnyis snang dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir: sku gsum bla ma'i dkyil 'khor dbyings nas bzhengs: thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir gshegs dgyes par bzhugs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu: slar yang dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs nas: yab yum snyoms zhugs bde ba'i rgyun chen pos: rdo rje'i dbang bskur sgrib gnyis bag chags dag: ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga'i phyag rgyar rdzogs: hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: su ra tā stāṃ a haṃ: na mo: skye 'gags 'gyur med chos sku kun tu 'chang : phrin las yongs rdzogs longs sku thod phreng rtsal: rang byung rig rtsal sprul pa'i mtshan mchog brgyad: sku gsum bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti bhū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha a la la hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: nyer spyod kun bzang 'dod yon phyag rgya gar: bde chen ting 'dzin rmad byung bstod pa'i dbyangs: sku gsum bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: mchod bzhes dam skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pū dza pra tīts+tsha ho: pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta kha hi: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje thod phreng thugs kar nyi zla'i dbus: hūm̐ mthar gsang ba'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: rtse gcig sems bzung mnyam par bzhag pa las: mi g.yo ting 'dzin dgongs pa mngon du gyur: de las sngags phreng lu gu rgyud du byung : gnas lnga'i thod phreng yab yum zhal du zhugs: gsang ba nas brgyud mgal me lta bur 'khor: bde stong nyams 'bar ye shes gzi byin rgyas:

sprul pa'i mtshan mchog brgyad kyi thugs dam bskul: so so'i sku las rigs kyi 'od zer 'phros: 'khor 'das kun khyab mdzad pa lhun gyis grub: tshur 'dus bdag thim byin rlabs nus stobs 'bar: slar yang bde gshegs rig 'dzin gu ru drug: sgo skyong rtsa gsum rab 'byams 'od zer gyis: snang grags rtog tshogs lha sngags ye shes ngang : mchog thun phrin las lhun gyis grub par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: lha sngags kun gyi khyab bdag ni: rdo rje'i yi ge bcu gnyis te: bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ldan gyi: ting 'dzin gcig tu dril byas la: 'bum phrag bcu gnyis bzlas pa yis: byin rlabs dngos grub thob par 'gyur: thun mthar dzab kyi mchod bstod bya: dag pa dran zhing nga rgyal brtan: phyi ltar bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha: nang du rdo rje lus kyi 'khor lor shar: gsang ba rtog tshogs rang graul gnyug ma'i gshis: dbyings rig dbyer med thig le chen por rdzogs: oṃ badz+ra kā ya dz+nyā na dhā tu a a: thun mtshams tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: thabs shes rdzas bsham byin gyis brlab: tshogs zhing spyan drangs dgyes pa bskyed: lhag ma'i gtor ma bskyang bar bya: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: tshogs rdzas gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i rtog pa kun: ye shes me rlung chu yis bsregs gtor bkrus: rdo rje'i yi ge drug gis byin brlabs pas: 'dod yon rmad byung bdud rtsi'i bcud du bskyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ snang srid dag pa dbyings kyi zhing khams nas: rig pa ye shes sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha: longs spyod tshogs gyi 'du bar spyan 'dren na: zung 'jug sgyu ma'i rol pas gnas 'dir gshegs: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dza: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes bdud rtsi'i 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin: sku gsum bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs dam dgyes bskang dam tshig nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol:
