oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ hoḥ bdag lus rang byung gzhal med khang : sha khrag drod dbugs ye shes rgyan: phung khams skye mched sku gsum lha: rtog tshogs rang grol phyag rgyar rdzogs: bza' bca' btung ba'i dam tshig rdzas: ye shes byang chub sems kyi rgyun: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po yis: mi 'gyur bde chen bskyed du gsol: ma hā su kha ga ṇa tsakra a la la ho: hūm̐ hrīḥ rig 'dzin rol pa'i bka' nyan lhag sdud tshogs: 'dod yon rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i phams phabs bzhes: rnal 'byor lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang : ye shes rig rtsal rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐ hrīḥ sku gsum bla ma bde gshegs rab 'byams lha: rang byung thugs rje chen po'i rtsal skyed la: snang grags rtog tshogs rdo rje'i gsang gsum dang : dbyer med mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsol: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags: hūm̐ hrīḥ lus dkyil lha rnams mkha' la sprin dengs ltar: rig pa mi 'gyur sku gsum klong du thim: rjes thob snang stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i sku: bde chen phyag rgya'i dam tshig mchog tu bzhengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: badz+ra kā wā tsidz+nyā na sa ma ya hoḥ hoḥ zab mo nang gi rnal 'byor la brten nas: sku gsum bla ma bsgrubs pa'i dge tshogs kyis: 'gro kun khyab bdag pad+ma thod phreng dang : dbyer med byang chub go 'phang myur thob shog: hūm̐ hrīḥ bkra shis gang zhig 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings: ye shes gzugs sku'i rnam rol cir yang ston: bla ma bde gshegs rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyis: byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs bkra shis shog: de ltar zab mo'i rnal 'byor la: thun bzhir rtse gcig brtson par bya: khyad par lha sku'i gsal snang la: brten nas tha mal zhen pa sbyang : dben par lus bsrang rlung ro bsal:

rang sems don gyi lhar shes shing : rig rtsal rdo rje lus kyi dal: chu zla 'ja' tshon lta bu la: yid mig rlung gsum rtse gcig gtad: bying na gzengs bstod lta stangs gzir: rgod na lhod kyis klod de bzhag: bying rgod med par dwangs ba'i mtshor: gzugs brnyan shar ba ji bzhin du: lha dang sems nyid 'dres pa na: yun thung grangs mang mnyam par bzhag: skabs su nga rgyal drag tu brten: res 'ga' gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum: dbyer med don dang brda yi tshul: bden gnyis zung 'jug dag pa dran: dang por rtog pa long long g.yo: de nas sems 'dzin cung zad thob: bar du goms pas phal cher zin: brtan pas yul sems shin sbyangs skye: mthar phyin rlung sems lha skur shar: rnam smin rig 'dzin 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: bskyed rim ci rigs goms pa yis: tshom bu tshogs dang bdud rtsi sman: 'chi med tshe dang las myur me: gzhan phan gnas kyi lung la brtson: dang po tshogs kyi sgrub pa ni: dben gnas skor khang rim gsum par: sgrub dang 'tsho ba'i yo byad bsags: gza' skar tshes grangs bzang po'i dus: ston 'khor phun sum tshogs pa yis: thog mar sa yi cho ga bya: phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshams bcad cing : bdag tu lta ba'i ru tra bsgral: khog par dur khrod pho brang btab: sngags kyis yo byad ba byin gyis brlab: lhag pa'i lha la snyan gsan dbab: bum pa ye shes bdud rtsir bskyil: snod ldan slob ma lhag par gnas: maṇ+ḍal thig dang tshon gyis bri: sgrub pa'i rdzas dang rgyan bkod cing : sgrub pa po rnams mnga' yang gsol: ye shes chen po'i gzi byin dbab: lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas: rang nyid nus dang ldan par bsten: rten dang brten pa yongs rdzogs lha: bdag mdun dbyer med nye bsnyen dang : so sor dbye ba'i sgrub pa yis: bzlas brjod chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bya: tshogs kyi 'khor lo dus drug bskor: bar chad nyu le tshar thag bcad:

byin chen dbab cing nyams chags bskong : de ltar rtse gcig brtson pa las: dngos grub mchog gi rtags byung na: srod la dgra bgegs 'byung po bsgral: nam gung snyoms 'jug bde chen bskyed: tho rangs mthar phyin sgrub pa ches: las dang ye shes dngos grub blang : slob ma smin byed dbang yang bskur: tshogs kyi dga' ston rgyas par bya: dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing mtshams yang dgrol: rnam dag smon lam rgya cher gdab: bkra shis me tog char du bsnyil: de ltar bsgrubs pa'i rnal 'byor pa: dngos grub thob pa lta ci smos: 'brel tshad bde chen ngang du grol: snod bcud bkra shis byin chen 'gyur: sa ma ya: bdud rtsi mchog gi sbyor ba ni: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang brgyud pa yi: khams lnga bcud kyi snying po ste: sha chen lnga yis nus pa bskyed: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar bas: dngos grub rab 'byams 'grub par 'gyur: de phyir rdzas rnams cho gas bran: 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis dri ma bsal: khrol bu thod phreng rigs lngas sbyangs: btags btsags sbol la phab kyis bran: rang byung bhan+dha'i snod du bskyil: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bskyed cing bzlas: khyad par bdud rtsi bsdu ba dang : dbab dang bskyil ba'i dmigs pa bcas: oṃ ma hā gu ru badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī thā: oṃ ma hā gu ru+u badz+ra a mṛ ta ā we sha ya a āḥ oṃ ma hā gu ru badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ hūm̐: rim par bzlas pas nus pa brtan: skabs su sman srung spyan drangs shing : rtog pa bsal nas las la bskul: sgrub pa chen pos gzhung bsrangs la: bdun phrag gcig gam gsum du brtson: ya mtshan gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra: bde rlung sems la dbang thob 'gyur: dri dang ro dang rgya cher 'phel: de tshe dngos grub tshul bzhin blang : snod ldan dbang gis rjes su bzung : gang zhig dri tsam tshor bas kyang : tshe ring nad med nyams chag skong : yid 'phrog dpal chen mthu rtsal ldan:

mchog gi rig 'dzin 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: 'chi med tshe yi cho ga ni: bkra shis sa la stegs bu bya: dkyil 'khor mtshan rdzogs tshul bzhin bzhengs: khyad par snying po'i 'brang rgyas ni: tshe yi rig pa'i srog ldan pa: nyi zla'i rgyan gyis spras pa dang : dngos grub thabs shes rdzas kyang bsham: las kyi gzhung bsrang bzlas pa'i dus: gtso bo'i thugs kar pad nyi zla ba'i steng : rig pa mi 'gyur ye shes tshe dpag med: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi'i tshe bum bsnams: rang 'od yum 'khyud longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: pad+ma rā ga'i 'od zer bye ba 'gyed: de yi thugs dbus nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs: hrīḥmathar tshe yi rig pas bskor ba las: lha mo mgyogs ma nyi zer rdul ltar 'phros: 'khor 'das thams cad mer mer shig shig g.yos: bla tshe 'phrog pa'i 'byung po zil gyis mnan: snod bcud dwangs ma rang dbang med par 'phrog: rtsa gsum rab 'byams bde chen thugs rgyud bskul: 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rnam par char ltar babs: bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim pa yis: bla srog sor chud 'byung lnga'i nus stobs 'phel: rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe dang lang tsho 'bar: ye shes mchog gi dngos grub thob par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ā' yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: skabs su tshe 'gugs thugs dam bskul: hūm̐ hrī: bzhengs shig bla ma bde gshegs rab 'byams tshogs: chos kyi dbyings las ye shes gzi byin skyed: sprul pa'i pho nya mgyogs ma las la bskul: thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcu kun tu spros: srid gsum gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyis: bskus dang 'phrog dang bzhoms pa'i tshe khug gcig: phyi nang ban bon sngags kyi sbyor ba yis: byad dang gtad du bcug pa'i tshe khug cig: brtan g.yo'i snod bcud 'byung ba rnam pa lnga'i: dwangs ma stobs su gyur pa'i tshe khug cig: phyogs bcu'i rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi:

mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes tshe khug cig: tshe khug g.yang skyobs srog gi ka ba tshugs: 'chi med rig 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub stsol: tshe mda' g.yab cing gdung shugs bskyed: rdo rje'i gsang sngags 'bru bco brgyad: 'bum phrag gsum du bzlas pa yis: bar chad sel zhing tshe bsod 'phel: rtags mthong dbang dang dngos grub blang : tshe dang ye shes rgyas par 'gyur: sa ma ya: las rnams myur du sgrub byed pa: myur lam me yi cho ga ni: las dang mthun pa'i chas gos dang : 'dug stangs lta phyogs ma nor bas: rdzas dang las dkyil 'du byas la: rung ba'i bud shing me sbar brlab: me lha dgug cing mchod byas la: 'bar ba'i klong du dkyil 'khor bskyed: dam tshig ye shes ldan byas te: mchod cing bstod de byon skyems dang : las dang mthun pa'i rdzas rnams 'bul: oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: oṃ dz+nya na brik+ṣa ya swā hā: oṃ sarba bigh+nān pā pa shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: bh+rūm̐ sarba ā yur puṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: hrīḥsarba lo ka dz+nyā na pā sha ku ru hoḥ hūm̐ sarba bigh+nan shā trūn mā' ra ya phaṭa: rtsa ba'i sngags la las kyi gzer: btags nas khyad par rdzas dang sbyar: ji ltar rigs pa phul byas te: las mthun 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par bsam: rjes su ye shes 'jig rten gyi: me lhar gtang rag 'bul ba dang : dngos grub gsol zhing nongs pa bshags: ye shes gshegs gsol dam tshig pa: 'bar ba'i 'od kyi rnam par bsam: bsngau smon bkra shis glu blangs pas: gang brtsams las kun myur du 'grub: rgyun gyi tshogs gsog me mchod ni: bzang shing me sbar skad cig gis: dkyil mkhor lha tshogs gsal btab nas: phye mar 'bru sman dri dang spos: ji ltar rigs pa me la bsreg: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi a mṛ ta pū dza ho: sarba karma ku ru hūm̐: brgya rtsa brgyad sogs ci 'byor 'bul:

hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes me dang dbyer med rig pa'i lha: zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang : dngos grub rnam gnyis 'bras bu stsal du gsol: sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: rjes ni mi dmigs ngang la bzhag: gang yang lha rnams zhal gyi sgo: me dang gnyis su med pa nyid: mnyes pas sdig sgrib kun sreg cing : gang 'dod las kun myur du 'grub: sa ma ya: nyam thag bar do'i yid can rnams: gnas kyi lung gis dbugs dbyung phyir: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin bsham: phyi nang mchod tshogs dpung bskyed la: phrin las gzhung bsrang bzlas brjod bya: khyad par las kyi bum pa ru: pad+ma kun tu 'chang ba nyid: gu ru drug gis bskor bar gsal: sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas: bum chu sgrib sbyong nus ldan bsam: gtso 'khor rig pa sham bcas bzla: mchod cing bstod la 'od du bzhu: dam bshags dam skong cho ga ni: rgyas par bya zhing tshogs 'khor bskor: tshe 'das ro 'am rus pa'am: ming byang rigs drug dal du bkod: gzugs brnyan bskyed cing rnam shes dgug: bgegs dang sdig pa sbyang byas la: dmyal ba'i gnas nas drang ba'i phyir: gtor ma byin la lan chags sbyang : hūm̐ hrīḥ 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor ma'i longs spyod 'di: tshe 'das zhe sdang rang gzugs las byung ba'i: dmyal ba'i lan chags bu lon sbyang phyir bsngo: tsha grang sdug bsngal kun las grol gyur cig: sarba pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa ba liṃ ta pra tīts+tsha ho: byang chub sems kyi chu yis bkru: hūm̐ hrīḥ bkra shis bum pa rang byung gzhal med khang : lha dang gnyis med ye shes rgyun gyis gtams: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la khrus bgyis pas: zhe sdang sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dag par shog: sngags dang yi ge brgya pas brab: khyad par bye ma yungs kar brdeg: hūm̐ hrī: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs rje'i snang ba yis: gu ru rnam par gnon pa'i thugs rgyud bskul:

ye shes 'od zer me lce lta bu yis: tshe 'das dmyal ba'i rgyu 'bras bsregs shing sbyangs: sngags dang bcas te thun gyis brab: gu ru'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: rkang mthil gnyis kyi duḥyig bsregs: dmyal ba'i rgyu 'bras dag par bsam: dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs 'gror dmigs: na mo:sku gsum bla ma bde gshegs dkyil 'khor dang : 'gro 'dul gu ru rnam par gnon pa la: tshe 'das phyag mtshal gus pas skyabs su mchi: tsha grang dmyal ba'i gnas nas drang du gsol: oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍa la na mā mi: lha tshogs thugs nas 'od 'phros pas: rnam par gnon pa'i thugs rgyud bskul: sku las rang 'dra gnyis pa 'phros: me long ye shes dbang bskur bsam: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos sku skye med ngang las longs spyod rdzogs: 'gro 'dul sprul sku rnam par gnon pa yis: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs zhe sdang sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras sbyangs: rdo rje'i rigs kyi zhing la dbang bsgyur nas: me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon gyur shog: sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: dmigs rten yi dwags dag du drang : rdo rjes phyir lam bcad nas kyang : hūm̐ hrīḥ sa 'di man chad tsha grang dmyal ba'i gnas: sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bzod dka' ya re nga : nges 'byung chen pos dkyil 'khor drung du snyogs: phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang thob par shog: sarba na ra ka duḥkha ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da hūm̐ phaṭa: de ltar dmyal ba'i gnas nas drangs: phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyas btab nas: yi dwags dud 'gro lha ma yin: lha dang mi'i gnas rigs las: lha sngags kha bsgyur rim bzhin drangs: rig 'dzin gral du 'khod par bsam: dmigs rten dkyil 'khor drung du bzhag: phyag 'tshal skyabs sems sdom pa sbyin: lhar bskyed ye shes dbab cing brtan: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur rnams: rgyas par bya'am mdor bsdu na: oṃ: bkra shis mi 'gyur dbyings kyi bum pa na:

rig pa rang snang ye shes lha yi tshogs: 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas: snang stong sku yi ye shes 'grub par shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: āḥ bde chen bhan+dhar stong nyid bcud du 'khyil: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsung dang gnyis su med: rtsa rlung byang chub sems la dbang bskur bas: grags stong gsung gi ye shes 'grub par shog: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: hūm̐: dbyings kyi ngo bo dag pa shel lta bu: ye shes rigs lnga 'ja' tshon bzhin du 'phro: zung 'jug don gyi dgongs pas dbang bskur bas: rig stong thugs kyi ye shes 'grub par shog: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje gsum ldan ye shes kyis: rgyal tshab sa la lhun grub bsam: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis mchod: hūm̐ hrīḥ nyon cig rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob khyod: 'khor ba'i gnas rigs kun la ma chags par: rlung sems snying po dwangs ma yid kyi lus: lha sngags ye shes phyag rgya'i dam tshig gis: lam lnga sa bcu skad cig nyid la bgrod: dbugs chen 'byin pa rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing : rang byung 'od gsal 'bar ba'i zhing khams su: de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dbyer med par: mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa mngon gyur shog: ces brjod phaṭa kyis rnam shes gshegs: snyigs ma ye shes me yis bsreg: sku gdung sāts+tsha gdab par bya: rnam dag bsngo smon rgya cher brjod: dkyil 'khor rjes chog tshul bzhin bsgrub: 'dis ni ngan 'gror 'gro ba yi: mtshams med las byas sems can kyang : thabs dang snying rje chen po'i mthus: mtho ris gnas su dbugs 'byin na: lam la gnas pa'i gang zag kun: thar pa thob pa smos ci dgos: de phyir sngags shes snying rje can: gzhan phan 'dod pas rab tu bsgrub: bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig las: rnal 'byor bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag dang bcas pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o: sa ma ya:
